digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: The bridge lacks a store-level mapping of tracker projects to repos, causing repo-wise project subsets against a shared snapshot to diff as remote deletions
projects.json must be created as a store-level record alongside bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json, owned by a new projects_store.py module with separate write cadence from binding_store.py
resolve_project must implement tri-state logic: absent ticket field returns legacy_default, explicit empty string returns None, explicit project key returns that key
The bridge projects verb group (list, set, remove) must be surfaced identically through CLI subcommands, library functions in _lib_ops.py, and MCP tools (list as read-only, set/remove as write tools)

An absent projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default; a malformed record raises; the pinned help file bridge.txt and argparse metavar must both list the projects verb
